description: This file contains test utility classes and functions for HTTP/2 adapter testing within the quiche project, including mock visitors, data sources, and frame matchers.

classes.name: DataSavingVisitor
classes.description: A mock HTTP/2 visitor that saves data and metadata for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestDataFrameSource
classes.description: A test data source for simulating data frames in HTTP/2 testing.

classes.name: TestMetadataSource
classes.description: A test metadata source for simulating metadata frames in HTTP/2 testing.

methods.name: OnReadyToSend
methods.description: Handles readiness to send data, respecting send limits and errors.

methods.name: OnMetadataForStream
methods.description: Handles incoming metadata for a specific stream.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves stored metadata for a specific stream.

methods.name: set_send_limit
methods.description: Sets the maximum amount of data to send.

methods.name: AppendPayload
methods.description: Appends payload data to the data source.

methods.name: EndData
methods.description: Marks the end of data in the data source.

methods.name: SelectPayloadLength
methods.description: Selects the payload length for sending data.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a data frame with specified header and payload length.

methods.name: send_fin
methods.description: Indicates if the stream should send a FIN flag.

methods.name: Pack
methods.description: Packs metadata entries into a frame.
